items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: Billy Byers, guys like that, Kent Hopkins. These guys could write

ctx.x: Was there certain arrangers whose names that you liked to see on the chart, and certain that you didn’t?

Oh yeah. Neal Hefti was one of them. Neal Hefti, now because you asked me that I can’t think of some, but there were several guys who you just broke your neck getting to the studio to work for them because it was always, always a joy. Billy Byers, guys like that, Kent Hopkins. These guys could write and Buddy Weed was another one, Glenn Osser, who was the conductor of the Miss America pageant. Like when we did the Miss America pageant it was always a joy because he wrote such beautiful arrangements. Everything…
What do you think of the state of music these days? How’s that for an open question?
